[spoiler=[b]Operation Red Falcon: Phase 5[/b]]
Valdderan troops had provided Hydronia with a crucial new piece of information relating to the whereabouts of Hassan Al-Amin, the brutal leader of the ISV. If the intelligence gathered by Valddera held true, then Hassan could be located in an underground compound in the easternmost regions of Valddera. So, the Hydronian search would continue in these areas.

Now that winter had set in, thermal imaging would be even more effective to help locate the compound, but even so, Cobra team would begin flying their helicopters even lower to maximise the chances of detection. And so they would. During a nightly aerial surveillance operation, a helicopter would pickup thermal traces, along with intercepting a communication from Hassans compound which would allow them to pinpoint its location.

Air support and ground troops would begin to flood into the location, surrounding a 5 miles radius around the location of the compound. Helicopters would provide constant surveillance on the ground to ensure that Hassan could not escape, whilst the army would form a human wall of sorts around the compounds location. Escape would be made near impossible without external support, which itself would be rendered difficult by the presence of a quickly deployable squadron of E-sahin-55 and HH-206 jets and the jamming capabilities employed by Hydronian ground forces, to prevent external communication.

Once these forces were in position, cobra team would be able to make their move. Hydronias top-tier counter-terror special forces would he airlifted into position outside the compound during the night and would break into the entrance swiftly, making use of explosives to blast down the door. Once inside, they would survey the immediate surroundings and take out any guards that may be present using high-precision DK Hassas rifles, manufactured specifically for special forces operations.

At this point, Hassan and his men would be well aware of the situation, but unable to do anything about it due to the heavy backup that was waiting outside. Their only option was to hide away deeper in the compound, which could only spare them more time, not save them. Working their way through the compound, room after room, cobra team would slowly gain control of the base. They would employ a simple strategy of using grenades to take our entire rooms and once, whilst simply shooting the stragglers. As far as they were concerned, the only person left alive in the compound should be them and Hassan.

Eventually they would find themselves standing outside the doors to the final room in the compound, where Hassan was hiding. Their usual strategy would not work here, as they had explicit orders to keep Hassan alive. Another problem would soon present itself to them, Hassan had armed himself, making capture even harder. A firefight would quickly ensue, with Hassan shooting as soon as the door was pushed a crack open, sending bullets and shrapnel spraying out into the corridor. One member of the team would get hit in the foot by Hassans wild shooting. The fight would continue for 10 minutes, with Hassan being blocked into his room, but Cobra team being unable to progress. That was until they had an idea. A fake grenade would be rolled into the room, which startled Hassan as he tried to take cover. In the split instant that he let his guard down, the team would simultaneously shoot him in the hand and the foot, immobilising him and unarming him. The troops would quickly rush in to apply the sedative, which would allow them to carry him out of the compound, along with their wounded brother, and place Hassan into a temporary prison cell for transfer.

Over the next day, Hassan would be swiftly transferred into the hands of the Valdderan Red army for them to do with him as they pleased. Another successful operation for cobra team.

Hydronian forces would not push further out from Vald at this point, working to simply keep hold of their captured territories, now stretching across around a quarter of Valdderas total territory. Whilst troops had been diverted for the operation against Hassan, the ISVs dwindling forces would not be unlikely to gain any ground, especially as Hydronia now predicted that the group would simply crumble around itself without Hassan.
[/spoiler]
